_comment: Written by tools/audit_carried.py. Per page: how many of the figures it computes appear in something it hands over, which ones do not, and the ceiling that count may not rise above (ADR-211).

declared.effective species: a Terrarium reading: this page's two live demonstrations are driven with sliders and redraw on every drag, so the figure is a picture of a parameter you are moving rather than a record of anything that happened. There is nothing to carry away -- the run that produced a number is the position of a slider, and the numbers that ARE a record are the stations' and the workbench's, both of which now leave with their own export (ADR-213, ADR-214).

declared.families: families in the loaded pack, not in the plot; the plot's own family count is the anStats tile next to it and that one is carried
declared.taxa in pack: a property of the reference flora pack the reader loaded, not of the plot they recorded -- the pack travels as its own file through 'Export pack', and repeating its size in a releve sheet would say something about the app rather than about the site

declared.known interactions: a count of the interaction records in the loaded species pack, not of anything measured in this stand; the pack is exported as itself and the stand sheet carries the interactions actually recorded on the plot
